summary.text: Soul Replacement is an immortal killer move that lets its user possess a body and lurk as an undercover agent.

claims.text: After Shadow Sect withdraws from Lang Ya blessed land, two hairy man Gu Immortals tell Qin Bai Sheng’s group they have the immortal killer move soul replacement. They already accumulated three hairy man Gu Immortal moles, two of them exposed, and they judge that accumulating more would take at least three hundred years.

Recognized as Shang clan’s Shang Gui Cai, a black robed Carefree Wisdom Heart immortal zombie says Shang Gui Cai is just an identity he used after soul replacement, and that Shang clan cannot compare to his great plan.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable names soul replacement as an immortal killer move he created, and likens Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable to it: Thieving Heaven’s soul is from another world, but his body was born here, so he is only half an otherworldly demon. Spectral Soul also holds that with human path methods he can create a completely new body, and after soul replacement he will become half an otherworldly demon.

Fang Yuan, reviewing Spectral Soul’s true inheritances, notes that Spectral Soul’s soul replacement technique could create a masterpiece spy like Sixth Hair, and that he had even inserted a spy in Heavenly Court.

Shadow Sect had used soul replacement to place Sixth Hair in Lang Ya blessed land and had not given him a lot of memories regarding cultivation, because once those memories exceeded a limit they could easily reveal flaws while cultivating, and Lang Ya land spirit could observe every small change in any part of the blessed land.

After modifying his sword path killer moves, Fang Yuan starts to modify soul path killer moves and practise them; besides split soul, the set includes Soul Suppression, soul howl, Soul Explosion, devour soul, soul replacement, soul beast summoning, and others. He does not have many soul path Immortal Gu, so he can use these moves again but the effects are greatly lowered.

Outside Beast Calamity grotto-heaven, Fang Yuan completes a prepared killer move and spits out a grey soul ball that shoots into the grotto-heaven at lightning speed. Myriad Beings Assimilation Transformation begins to affect the ball; transformation path dao marks on its surface are expended to resist that power and keep its shape, and without those dao marks it would likely become an ancient soul beast. He watches through heaven form as the ball reaches a city and finds a beaten poor lad. The ball arrives just in time, and this good luck is not a coincidence, it is influenced by Fang Yuan’s own luck. Seeing nobody around, it enters the chest, envelops the mortal soul, and destroys it in almost an instant. The grey soul ball expands into the young man’s appearance, occupies the body, and takes over as the native Zhan Bu Du; this grey soul ball is the soul path killer move Soul Replacement. Shadow Sect had used this move to plant spies in Lang Ya blessed land, and the traitor Sixth Hair was still alive; the grey soul ball originates from Fang Yuan’s desolate soul and cannot be detected by land spirits or heavenly spirits, which is the specialty of soul replacement, and if not for that, Lang Ya land spirit would have discovered Shadow Sect’s spies long ago. Fang Yuan modified soul replacement on that foundation, adding many transformation path Immortal Gu so the grey soul ball can resist myriad beings assimilation transformation; after the replacement succeeds, his actions are observable by the heavenly spirit, though he has already destroyed the lad’s soul and obtained his memories. In Profound Literature grotto-heaven, a young male scholar looks at his reflection and takes the name Li Xiao Bai.
Fang Yuan has already used soul replacement in both grotto-heavens, then waits for the clones to develop while he continues cultivating.

Known users.text: Spectral Soul Demon Venerable (creator) Fang Yuan
